outline.unique_angle: A specific, irreproducible first-person case study where AI mis-attributed causation (language vs attachment) because the decisive fact — which parent did drop-off that day — lives only in the educator's relational knowledge. Top-3 all assert 'AI lacks context' abstractly; none demonstrate a concrete mis-tag with the real cause revealed. We show the exact failure mechanism, then give a reusable 'when NOT to' gut-check. This is E-E-A-T (lived experience) the AI Overview cannot compress.
outline.coverage_grounding: H2s 1-4 mirror the union of top-3 coverage (observation method + AI-assist + AI-limitation) but ground each in the anecdote rather than asserting abstractly. H5 ('when NOT to') fills the snippet gap none of the top-3 own. H6 keeps it balanced/credible (not anti-AI), matching the empoweredducator/Famly nuance that AI is fine for plain-language rewrites.
